text:
Rohan: quick async check — prepping a new model for serve. need eyes on weights location, tokenizer quirks (NBSP), config lint, and reference-prompt/regression for structured tool-calls. who can review today? pings @Alyssa @Keven
Alyssa: +1, can look in ~2h. which s3 path?
Rohan: paths: s3://redwood-models/uploads/rlhf/llama3/v3.1/weights/sha-abc123.tar.gz and manifest at s3://redwood-models/uploads/rlhf/llama3/v3.1/weights/manifest.json. tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/uploads/rlhf/llama3/v3.1/tokenizer/tokenizer.json. note: tokenizer converted from sentencepiece preserved NBSP (U+00A0) — might break prefix matching.
Keven: i'll check tokenizer. quick grep shows special tokens: "unk": "<unk>", "pad": "<pad>", "nb": "\\u00A0". could cause leading-space mismatch. suggest adding normalizer in config: "unicode_normalizer": "NFKC" or map NBSP->space in pre-tokenize.
Maria: for config lint, run `python infra/config_lint.py --model-path s3://redwood-models/uploads/rlhf/llama3/v3.1`. focus on `runtime.max_seq`, `kvcache.enabled`, and `quant.params`. i noticed manifest missing `preferred_kernel` — fallback to cpu. example suggested snippet:
```json
{
  "model_name": "llama3-v3.1",
  "runtime": {"max_seq": 4096, "kvcache": true},
  "kernels": {"preferred": "auto"}
}
```
Rohan: thanks. also need reference prompts for structured outputs / tool-call. i'm adding two reference prompts in repo at `evals/ref_prompts/llama3_v3_structured.yaml`. can someone sanity-run the regression harness: `pytest -q tests/regression/test_structured.py::test_tool_call --model-path s3://redwood-models/uploads/rlhf/llama3/v3.1` ?
Alyssa: running now. small timeout on my run, model returns `{\"action\":\"search\", \"args\": {\"q\":\"laptop\"}}` and passes schema, but tokenizer produced silent NBSP in outputs: example returned `laptop\\u00A013-inch` which fails strict comparator. propose adding postprocess normalize_nbsp = True in eval harness.
Keven: pushed patch in PR #482 to add tokenizer sanitizer in `serve_adapter.py`:
```py
def sanitize_output(text):
    return text.replace("\\u00A0", " ")
```
added unit test. @Alyssa can you re-run with that patch?
Alyssa: reran, test passes locally. noticed a flake in batching config: `batch.max_tokens` set to 4096 but should be 2048 for this GPU profile. filed infra#1092 to adjust autoscale hints.
DevInfraBot: Deploy check triggered for model path s3://redwood-models/uploads/rlhf/llama3/v3.1; preflight lints: manifest OK, tokenizer schema OK, kms policy missing tags -> WARN. link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/checks/1943216789
Rohan: great — i'll merge PRs and add NBSP normalization in the eval harness. quick code-review ping @Keven @Maria on PR #482 and #483 (config defaults). if no objections by EOD i'll promote to canary tomorrow 04:00 UTC.
Keven: LGTM from me.
Maria: reviewing now, will finish in 1h.
Rohan: thanks all :tada:
